scope: Synthetic reply-v2 prompt-component smoke comparison on unchanged Luna/high, plus offline host regressions. No quality or latency superiority claim.
controls: Strict response schema and existing host validation; one question and extract for story cases, pause/no question/reply_only for whole stops, recall_limit/no model question/extract for recall difficulty.

review.reviewer: Codex inspection, known variant labels; no independent human or blind judge
findings: Both arms produce one relevant follow-up for each story case and respect the supplied topic pause.
Neither arm repeats the library-route question after a partial answer introduces a book club.
Known companionship is not asked again; no new-scene question asserts old companions were present.
Simplified new-scene questions follow the walk without requiring company/time anchors.
Simplified reflection questions explore remembered late evenings; baseline asks what led to the narrator's interpretation. Both follow the current account.
Both arms still routinely recap answers. Some Chinese simplified questions remain generic invitations to recall more detail. Naturalness has no established winner.

limitations: One sample per language/scenario/arm; twenty responses per arm.
Draft-source component comparison only; no live privacy review, concurrent Lane B, durable application saves, browser, long-history session or composed memoir.
Requested route/effort is not independent proof of upstream serving policy.
Normal serving prompt receipts remain unpublished; no service config or deployment changed.
Provider-internal retries and monetary cost were not measured.
